sections.term_1: 1. PARTY A (Landlord) commits to handover the room with correct area and equipment as agreed, and ensure the independent, legal usage rights of PARTY B (Tenant).
sections.term_2: 2. PARTY B commits to pay the rent on time, use the room for legal residential purposes only, and not sublease the room without prior written consent from PARTY A.
sections.term_3: 3. SECURITY DEPOSIT: Used to secure the performance of all obligations by PARTY B. The deposit will be fully refunded to PARTY B after contract termination and room handover in its original state, minus any damage costs caused by PARTY B (if any).
sections.term_4: 4. TERMINATION: Either party wishing to terminate the contract early must notify the other party at least 30 days in advance. Violation of this clause will incur compensation equivalent to the deposit.
sections.no_additional_terms: No additional terms from the landlord.
sections.agree_terms_checkbox: I have read and agree to the contract terms listed above.
